summary: Iter 22 backend + frontend tested. P0 grounding bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end: LLM correctly returns 'I don't have verified data for zorplok curry' with NO invented SAFE/CAUTION/AVOID tier. All 15 pytest cases pass (100%). Frontend NL meal-logging flow (login -> /meal-log -> Log by text -> parse -> pick candidates -> commit -> back to /meal-log) works with all required testIDs present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1760 lines — should be split into routers (auth, foods, meal_logs, ai) in a future iteration.
seed_data_creation: None — tests use existing food-apple, food-toor-dal seed rows and clean up all created meal logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 22 P0 fix verified: /ai/ask against a made-up dish name ('zorplok curry') returns the exact 'I don't have verified data...' disclaimer with zero tier verdicts. Guide-only foods (khoa RED, water chestnut YELLOW) correctly retrieved via _find_relevant_guide_entries. /ai/log-meal returns parsed items with candidates that OMIT nutrient fields (potassium_mg confirmed absent). No-write invariant confirmed. quantity_multiplier flows through create -> GET list -> summary -> weekly report (67.7 mg avg K delta = 3 * 158 / 7 to 1 decimal). Validation: qty=0 -> 422, qty=15 -> 422, omitted -> default 1.0. Regression endpoints /foods, /foods/food-toor-dal, /auth/me, /meal-logs all 200.
rca_of_issue: P0 root cause (per problem statement): base system prompt instructed the model to classify Indian foods as SAFE/CAUTION/AVOID as a blanket rule, and _build_grounded_food_block returned an empty string on no-match so the model happily invented tiers from general knowledge. Fix (verified in this iteration): (a) AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE now has an explicit GROUNDING RULE that forbids tiering foods absent from the grounded block and dictates the exact 'I don't have verified data' disclaimer response; (b) _build_grounded_food_block now returns an explicit '(no matching food found...)' marker instead of an empty string when both DB and guide retrieval come up empty; (c) _find_relevant_guide_entries added as a second retrieval path over the 6 curated guides so reference-only entries (Khoa, Water Chestnut) are visible to /ai/ask.
